summary: Implement SP-02 branch-scoped Purchase Order operations, direct purchase orchestration, operational supplier fulfillment evidence, retry-safe receipt/correction workflows, API composition, persistence, Arabic-first web surfaces, and the minimal Nest/public boundary corrections required to keep accounting/application APIs free of composition-side effects.
protectedReason: SP-02 implements the architecture-approved procurement-fulfillment owner, extends the canonical Procurement Finance PO owner with authoritative branch/commercial and exact receipt-outcome evidence, adds a minimal Platform Core idempotent-audit public capability required for retry-safe operational auditing, wires API/web composition, and adds one forward migration. During execution-gate validation, existing Procurement Finance, Tourism Contract Inventory, and Tourism Finance Orchestration public barrels were proven to leak Nest composition into non-Nest application/historical-import test paths. Their module manifests are therefore explicitly updated to declare dedicated /nest public entrypoints. This preserves owner boundaries and prevents controllers/composition roots from being loaded by application APIs; it does not create a second PO, supplier-invoice, payment, or accounting truth.
publicApiBreakingReason: Architecture correction only: the runtime Nest module symbols ProcurementFinanceModule, TourismContractInventoryModule, TOURISM_CONTRACT_INVENTORY_SERVICE, and TourismFinanceOrchestrationModule move from each package root public barrel to the package's explicit /nest entrypoint. Application/domain/historical APIs remain at the root, all repository consumers in this change are migrated to /nest, and the change prevents non-Nest code paths from eagerly loading Nest controllers. No business contract, persisted financial truth, or domain semantics are removed.
